entries.answer:
I can’t actually determine your real favorite female wrestler from astrology alone, because a birth chart cannot verify a personal preference as a fact.  But I can make a thoughtful, chart-based **best-fit guess** about the kind of female wrestler you are most likely to be drawn to, using the placements and aspects you gave.[1]

## Chart pattern

Your chart is built around strong tension between softness and force, which points toward wrestlers who feel intense, dominant, stylish, emotionally charged, and impossible to ignore. The biggest signatures are Sun in Aries, Moon in Libra, Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 7th house, Venus in Pisces, and a set of hard Venus-Saturn-Pluto and Sun-Mars contacts, all of which together suggest attraction to performers who combine raw competitiveness with magnetism and dramatic presence.[1]

Sun opposite Moon often creates a taste for contrast, so you are less likely to prefer someone one-note or purely wholesome; you would probably gravitate toward someone who can balance beauty and aggression, charisma and menace, elegance and brutality. Mars in Capricorn is especially important here because it tends to admire control, discipline, credibility, physical authority, and people who look like they can actually dominate a division rather than merely entertain in it.[1]

## What the aspects imply

Sun square Mars with a very tight orb is one of the loudest features in the whole chart, and it usually points toward admiration for fighters with heat, edge, confrontation, and an “I run this place” aura. Moon sextile Pluto and Moon trine Neptune add emotional fascination with intensity, myth, image, and darker glamour, while Venus square Pluto pushes attraction toward women with a hypnotic, dangerous, high-impact presence rather than a light or purely comedic vibe.[1]

Venus sextile Mars says you still want chemistry and appeal, but Venus square Saturn means you may respect wrestlers who seem hardened, battle-tested, serious, and not too sugary. Vertex trine Venus and Vertex sextile Mars strengthen the idea that your strongest favorites would likely be women who feel both aesthetically compelling and physically threatening at the same time.[1]

## Best-fit wrestler

My strongest guess is **Rhea Ripley**. That is the clearest fit for a chart that mixes Aries fire, Libra image-consciousness, Capricorn dominance, Pisces glamour, and Pluto-style intensity, because her presentation is powerful, severe, magnetic, rebellious, visually distinct, and emotionally charged in exactly the kind of way your placements suggest you would fixate on.[1]

She fits the Mars in Capricorn theme of authority and controlled violence, the Venus-Pluto theme of dark attraction, and the Libra-Pisces side that still wants strong aesthetics and a memorable look. A secondary possibility would be Becky Lynch, especially if your taste leans more toward fire, status, grit, and narrative resilience than toward dark dominance, since she is widely recognized as one of WWE’s biggest women’s stars.[1]

## Ranking

If I turn your whole chart into a likely preference ranking, I would put it roughly like this: Rhea Ripley first, Becky Lynch second, then perhaps Charlotte Flair or Bianca Belair depending on whether you respond more to elite command or polished star power. The reason I would not put a softer or more purely bubbly wrestler at number one is that your chart repeatedly emphasizes intensity, friction, authority, and fascination with strong personas over simple sweetness.[1]

So my answer is: your most likely favorite female wrestler is **Rhea Ripley**. Would you like me to do a much stricter aspect-by-aspect breakdown and rank 10 women wrestlers against your chart one by one?
